title: Cod en Papillote with Fennel
description: Cod fillets baked in parchment with fennel, cherry tomatoes and white wine for a fragrant, moist dinner.
steps: Layer the fennel, tomatoes and fish onto parchment paper.
Add the wine, lemon slices and dill, then fold and seal into a parcel.
Bake at 200C for 15-18 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food fish recipe collection

notes: Cooking in parchment traps the steam so the fish stays moist with almost no added fat.
